# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2020

**An Ordinance Granting Franchise to Mrs. Rosita L. Batralo to Operate and Maintain a Cockpit Arena in the Municipality of Pitogo, Province of Quezon**

## Summary

Enacted on February 17, 2020, this ordinance grants a franchise to [[Rosita L. Batralo]] to establish, operate, and maintain a cockpit arena in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]]. The ordinance notes the local tourism and economic benefits of cockfighting as a traditional form of recreation. [[Rosita L. Batralo|Mrs. Batralo]] filed her application individually, submitting her birth certificate, proof of Filipino citizenship, and tax returns as supporting documentation. This franchise was later amended by [[MO-05-S2023]].

## Key Provisions

- **Grant of Franchise.** The [[Sangguniang Bayan]] grants a franchise to [[Rosita L. Batralo]] for the establishment, operation, and maintenance of a cockpit arena within [[Pitogo]].
- **Qualifications.** The grantee submitted the required documentary proof including birth certificate, citizenship proof, and income tax returns.
- **Terms and Conditions.** The franchise is subject to the terms, conditions, and regulatory requirements prescribed by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] and applicable national laws.
- **Local Tourism.** The ordinance recognizes cockfighting as a traditional activity that contributes to local tourism and economic activity.
- **Regulatory Compliance.** The franchisee must comply with all applicable rules and regulations governing cockfighting operations, including those under Rule I Article 3(d) and Rule XVII Article 100(3)(v).
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
